description: Real approved labels from the TTB Public COLA Registry, each paired with the application fields it must match, plus flawed variants derived from them. See docs/research/2026-09-15-test-labels.md.
warning_text_27_cfr_16_21: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.

check_rules.brand: Application brand name appears on the label; case, punctuation and spacing differences pass.
check_rules.class_type: Label class/type designation is the application's class/type or a designation within it (spelling variants such as WHISKY/WHISKEY pass).
check_rules.abv: Label alcohol content equals the application value.
check_rules.net_contents: Label net contents equal the application value.
check_rules.name_address: Label names the applicant or a DBA the application lists as used on label, with its city and state.
check_rules.origin: Imports: label states the application's country of origin. Domestic: not_applicable.
check_rules.warning_present: The 27 CFR 16.21 statement is on the label.
check_rules.warning_exact: Same words, numbers and punctuation as 27 CFR 16.21. Letter case, spacing, line breaks and hyphens that split a word at a line end are ignored; the heading's capitals are scored separately by warning_heading_caps.
check_rules.warning_heading_caps: 'GOVERNMENT WARNING' is in capital letters (27 CFR 16.22(a)(2)). Bold type, also required there, is not scored by this set.
check_rules.expected_for_real_labels: Real labels were approved by TTB, so field checks expect 'pass'. Warning checks record what the label actually shows against the regulation text, so an approved label can expect warning_exact false.
check_rules.application_value_sources: Current registry records do not carry alcohol content or net contents; where source is read_from_label, the value was read from the label image and stands in for the application value.
check_rules.also_acceptable: Other outcomes that count as correct for a check: 'needs_review' where the label and application differ in a way a reviewer should look at, and on every check of an image-degradation variant.
check_rules.label_observed: What the label itself shows, transcribed from its images: the brand mark it displays, its alcohol and net-contents declarations with the unit words as printed, the name-and-address and origin statements, and the health warning. It is read off the label without reference to the application, so the two sides of every comparison are independent.
check_rules.label_observed_brand: The brand reading is the brand mark the label displays, not the application's brand string wherever it happens to be printed. Searching the label for a string the application already supplies would compare a value with itself, and a reader that has not seen the application cannot do it.
check_rules.label_observed_net_contents: The net-contents reading is the quantity the label declares, as a number plus the unit words as printed. Where the label prints the same quantity in both metric and US customary units, the reading is the metric figure the label itself prints. Where it prints no metric figure, the reading is the first numeric customary quantity. Where it declares several different quantities, there is no single reading and the amount is null.
